text: Deploy serverless functions and full-stack apps globally with no servers to manage and no cold starts.
quote: Build and deploy serverless functions and full-stack apps on Cloudflare's global network. No servers to manage. No cold starts or region complexity.

text: Scaffold and create a new app with a single CLI command.
quote: npm create cloudflare@latest my-app

text: Run AI inference globally with one API call, no GPU or capacity management needed.
quote: Run AI inference globally with one API call, build agents, and search across your data — no GPUs to manage, no capacity planning.

text: Query serverless SQL and globally distributed key-value/database directly from Workers with no connection management.
quote: Serverless SQL, globally distributed key-value, and global database acceleration — query directly from Workers with no connection management.

text: Build scalable media pipelines to store, optimize, and deliver images.
quote: Cloudflare Images helps teams build scalable, reliable media pipelines to store, optimize, and deliver images.

text: Build full-stack apps using popular frameworks like React, Vue, Svelte, Next, Astro, React Router.
quote: Build full-stack apps with your framework of choice, including React, Vue, Svelte, Next, Astro, React Router, and more

text: Write Workers in your preferred language including JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Rust, and more.
quote: Use your preferred language, including JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Rust, and more

text: Build APIs and connect to data stores with Smart Placement to optimize latency.
quote: Build APIs and connect to data stores with Smart Placement to optimize latency

text: Schedule cron jobs, run durable Workflows, and integrate with Queues.
quote: Schedule cron jobs, run durable Workflows, and integrate with Queues

text: Connect to external services like databases, APIs, and storage via Bindings with minimal code.
quote: Connect to external services like databases, APIs, and storage via Bindings, enabling functionality with just a few lines of code

text: Wrangler CLI offers commands to manage Cloudflare Workers.
quote: Wrangler offers a number of commands to manage your Cloudflare Workers.

text: Build and deploy Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers on Cloudflare.
quote: You can build and deploy Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers on Cloudflare.

text: Cloudflare issues and auto-renews free, unshared, publicly trusted SSL certificates for domains.
quote: Cloudflare issues — and renews — free, unshared, publicly trusted SSL certificates to all domains added to and activated on Cloudflare.

text: Select which specific resources an API token is authorized to access, enabling scoped credentials.
quote: Select which resources the token is authorized to access.

text: Billing is based only on active compute time, not wall clock time, even for long workflows or hibernating WebSockets.
quote: Cloudflare charges only for compute, not wall time, even during long agent workflows or hibernating WebSockets.

text: A local simulator (workerd-powered) lets developers develop and test Workers matching the production runtime.
quote: A simulator for developing and testing Cloudflare Workers, powered by workerd

text: Official command line tool for building Cloudflare Workers.
quote: A command line tool for building [Cloudflare Workers](https://workers.cloudflare.com/).

text: Smart Placement automatically moves Worker execution closer to backend data for optimized latency.
quote: Smart Placement moves your Worker closer to your data for optimized end-to-end latency.

text: Fits into existing workflows: Git, GitHub Actions, VS Code, and any framework, with no proprietary tooling or lock-in.
quote: Fits into your existing workflows: Git, GitHub Actions, VS Code, and any framework. No proprietary tools or vendor lock-in.

text: DDoS protection, WAF, bot management, and Zero Trust controls run on every request by default.
quote: DDoS protection, WAF, bot management, and Zero Trust controls are built into the network and run on every request from day one.

text: Core Wrangler commands support creating, developing, and deploying Workers from the CLI.
quote: The core Wrangler commands for creating, developing, and deploying Workers are on the Workers commands page.

text: Scoped API tokens can be restricted to read access on a single zone/resource, e.g. DNS read on one domain.
quote: granting Zone DNS Read access to a zone example.com will allow the token to read DNS records only for that specific zone

text: Built-in observability provides deep visibility into Worker behavior.
quote: Gain deep visibility and insight with built-in observability

text: Roll back to a previously deployed Worker version via Wrangler or the dashboard.
quote: You can roll back to a previously deployed version of your Worker using Wrangler or the Cloudflare dashboard.
